It decides whether physical tokens (miniatures with 3–4 conductive feet in a unique geometry) can be recognised by touch.
Read first: claude-code-game-master/build/ai-table-human-gm/research/physical-tokens.md and claude-code-game-master/build/ai-table-human-gm/PLAN.md §4 (V-67 row in §5).

It will be published publicly — no secrets, no internal hostnames or paths in the page.
The page (Russian UI, the AI-table concept look: dark, gold display font Forum, parchment/gold accents from claude-code-game-master/build/ai-table-redesign/tokens.css — copy the few variables you need inline):
1. Full-viewport canvas, no scroll ever (100dvh, overflow hidden, touch-action none, block context menu, pinch, double-tap zoom, text selection).
2. Draws every active pointer: a ring with id, position in px and mm, width/height, pressure, pointerType; listens to Pointer Events AND Touch Events (touches.length, radiusX/Y, force) and shows both counts.
3. Big counters: active now and MAX seen simultaneously (pointer and touch separately), navigator.maxTouchPoints, pointercancel count, devicePixelRatio, screen and viewport size, user agent.
4. Screen diagonal input (default 43, in inches) → mm per CSS px from the screen aspect; show distances between touches in mm and group touches closer than 70 mm into clusters: for each cluster show the number of points, side lengths in mm and angles — this is the token​-geometry readout.
5. Token​ test: per touch, its lifetime in seconds; a log of down/up/cancel with durations; a clear hint "Поставьте фишку, держите, потом отпустите руку — если точки остались, фишка видна без руки".
6. Buttons (≥ 48 px, icon + one word): «Сброс», «Отчёт» — copies a plain-text report (all maxima, maxTouchPoints, UA, diagonal, cancel count, longest lifetimes, last clusters with distances) to the clipboard and also shows it in a sheet so it can be photographed.
7. A short 4-step instruction overlay on first open (all fingers → token held → [скрыто] → «Отчёт»), dismissible with one tap.
Check it works: in ONE headless Chromium on the hub (run with `nice -n 10` and `echo 1000 > /proc/self/oom_score_adj` in the same shell; kill it by PID afterwards; one browser only), serve claude-code-game-master/build/ai-table-human-gm/touch-lab with `python3 -m http.server <free port> --bind 127.0.0.1` (kill by PID after), use CDP Input.dispatchTouchEvent to put 5 simultaneous touch points (two of them forming a 3-point cluster ~20–30 mm apart at 43″), move one, release some; take screenshots at 1920×1080 and 390×844 into claude-code-game-master/build/ai-table-human-gm/touch-lab/check/ (PNG or WebP ≤ 400 KB); confirm: max counter shows 5, cluster readout appears with plausible mm, report text contains the numbers, no console errors, document has no scroll (scrollHeight == innerHeight).

import sys, json, time, base64, urllib.request
sys.path.insert(0, '/tmp/tlchk')
from cdp import WS
HTTP = int(sys.argv[1]); DBG = int(sys.argv[2]); OUT = sys.argv[3]
tgt = json.load(urllib.request.urlopen(urllib.request.Request(f'http://127.0.0.1:{DBG}/json/new?about:blank', method='PUT')))
ws = WS(tgt['webSocketDebuggerUrl'])
errs = []
def drain():
    ws.pump(0.15)
    for e in ws.events:
        m = e.get('method')
        if m == 'Runtime.exceptionThrown': errs.append(('exc', json.dumps(e['params']['exceptionDetails'])[:300]))
        if m == 'Runtime.consoleAPICalled' and e['params']['type'] in ('error', 'warning'): errs.append(('console', json.dumps(e['params']['args'])[:300]))
        if m == 'Log.entryAdded' and e['params']['entry']['level'] in ('error', 'warning'): errs.append(('log', json.dumps(e['params']['entry'])[:300]))
    ws.events.clear()
for m in ('Runtime.enable', 'Log.enable', 'Page.enable'): ws.call(m)
def ev(expr):
    r = ws.call('Runtime.evaluate', {'expression': expr, 'returnByValue': True, 'awaitPromise': True})
    if 'exceptionDetails' in r: errs.append(('eval', json.dumps(r['exceptionDetails'])[:300]))
    return r['result'].get('value')
def shot(name):
    r = ws.call('Page.captureScreenshot', {'format': 'webp', 'quality': 88})
    open(f'{OUT}/{name}.webp', 'wb').write(base64.b64decode(r['data']))
def tp(i, x, y, rx=14, ry=12, f=0.5): return {'x': x, 'y': y, 'id': i, 'radiusX': rx, 'radiusY': ry, 'force': f}
def touch(t, pts):
    ws.call('Input.dispatchTouchEvent', {'type': t, 'touchPoints': pts}); time.sleep(0.05)
def tap(x, y):
    touch('touchStart', [tp(99, x, y)]); touch('touchEnd', [])
def setup(w, h, dpr, mobile):
    ws.call('Emulation.setDeviceMetricsOverride', {'width': w, 'height': h, 'deviceScaleFactor': dpr, 'mobile': mobile, 'screenWidth': w, 'screenHeight': h})
    ws.call('Emulation.setTouchEmulationEnabled', {'enabled': True, 'maxPoints': 10})
def center(sel):
    r = ev(f"(()=>{{const b=document.querySelector({json.dumps(sel)}).getBoundingClientRect();return [b.x+b.width/2,b.y+b.height/2]}})()")
    return r
res = {}
def scenario(tag, w, h, dpr, mobile, diag, pts):
    setup(w, h, dpr, mobile)
    ws.call('Page.navigate', {'url': f'http://127.0.0.1:{HTTP}/index.html'})
    time.sleep(1.0); ev("localStorage.clear()"); ws.call('Page.reload'); time.sleep(1.2); drain()
    shot(f'{tag}-0-overlay')
    x, y = center('#bGo'); tap(x, y); time.sleep(0.3)
    ev(f"(()=>{{const i=document.getElementById('diag');i.value='{diag}';i.dispatchEvent(new Event('input'))}})()")
    ev("window.__touchlab.state()")
    A, B, C, D, E = pts
    touch('touchStart', [tp(1, *A)])
    touch('touchStart', [tp(1, *A), tp(2, *B)])
    touch('touchStart', [tp(1, *A), tp(2, *B), tp(3, *C)])
    touch('touchStart', [tp(1, *A), tp(2, *B), tp(3, *C), tp(4, *D, 20, 18, 0.8)])
    touch('touchStart', [tp(1, *A), tp(2, *B), tp(3, *C), tp(4, *D, 20, 18, 0.8), tp(5, *E, 9, 9, 0.3)])
    time.sleep(1.3)
    res[tag + '_after5'] = ev("window.__touchlab.state()")
    # move one
    for i in range(1, 6):
        touch('touchMove', [tp(1, A[0] + 4 * i, A[1] + 2 * i), tp(2, *B), tp(3, *C), tp(4, *D, 20, 18, 0.8), tp(5, *E, 9, 9, 0.3)])
    A2 = (A[0] + 20, A[1] + 10)
    time.sleep(0.8); drain()
    shot(f'{tag}-1-five-touches')
    res[tag + '_clusterDom'] = ev("document.getElementById('clusters').innerText")
    # release D and E (the hand), [скрыто] stays
    touch('touchEnd', [tp(1, *A2), tp(2, *B), tp(3, *C), tp(5, *E, 9, 9, 0.3)])
    touch('touchEnd', [tp(1, *A2), tp(2, *B), tp(3, *C)])
    time.sleep(1.0)
    ev("document.getElementById('bFree').click()")  # 'видна'
    shot(f'{tag}-2-token-without-hand')
    res[tag + '_state_after_release'] = ev("window.__touchlab.state()")
    x, y = center('#bRep'); tap(x, y); time.sleep(0.6); drain()
    shot(f'{tag}-3-report')
    res[tag + '_report'] = ev("document.getElementById('rep').textContent")
    res[tag + '_toast'] = ev("document.getElementById('toast').textContent")
    res[tag + '_scroll'] = ev("({sh:document.documentElement.scrollHeight,ih:innerHeight,sw:document.documentElement.scrollWidth,iw:innerWidth,bsh:document.body.scrollHeight,sy:scrollY,mtp:navigator.maxTouchPoints,pNow:pNow.textContent,pMax:pMax.textContent,tMax:tMax.textContent,mtpTxt:mtp.textContent})")
    x, y = center('#bClose'); tap(x, y); time.sleep(0.2)
    touch('touchEnd', [])
    time.sleep(0.2); drain()
scenario('d1920', 1920, 1080, 1, False, 43, [(900, 500), (951, 505), (922, 548), (300, 300), (1500, 700)])
scenario('m390', 390, 844, 2, True, 6.1, [(150, 400), (190, 404), (168, 436), (60, 560), (320, 610)])
drain()
res['errors'] = errs
print(json.dumps(res, ensure_ascii=False, indent=1))
